data.summary: The "fd" directory is a single scenario definition in a declarative Docker image build system (aio-config). It pairs a scenario.toml metadata file (id, category, installer, pinned version 10.5.0) with a fragment.Dockerfile that installs the `fd` find-alternative via `mise use -g` and then verifies the binary resolves in both login and non-login shells. Together they form an idempotent, composable L2 shell-layer install fragment rather than application business logic.

file_insights.name: fragment.Dockerfile
file_insights.summary: Docker build fragment that installs the `fd` CLI at a parameterized version through mise and asserts the binary is on PATH for both login and non-login shells.
file_insights.source_summary: Declares `ARG FD_VERSION={{version}}`, then runs `mise use -g "fd@${FD_VERSION}"`, lists the installed fd, and executes `command -v fd` checks under both `bash -lc` (login) and `bash -c` (non-login) shells, exiting 1 with a MISSING diagnostic if not found. The visible content is truncated mid-command, but the pattern is install-then-verify.
file_insights.detailed_description: This fragment is a self-contained, composable Dockerfile snippet generated from a scenario template, using ARG FD_VERSION to pin the fd release. It relies on mise's read-modify-write `use -g` semantics so multiple tool fragments can be layered in any Docker layer order without aggregation. Post-install verification steps fail the build early if `fd` is not resolvable in either shell mode.
responsibilities: Install the pinned fd version globally via mise (aqua backend) into /opt/mise/installs
Verify fd is discoverable on PATH in login and non-login shells
Expose the pinned version as a build ARG for template substitution
Remain idempotent and order-independent when composed with other mise tool fragments

file_insights.name: scenario.toml
file_insights.summary: Scenario metadata consumed by `aio-config gen` that identifies the fd scenario, its category, installer backend, and pinned version list.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines id = "fd", name = "fd", a Chinese-language description noting fd is a user-friendly find replacement installed via the mise aqua backend into /opt/mise/installs, category = "shell", installer = "mise", and one [[versions]] table with label and version both set to "10.5.0".
file_insights.detailed_description: This TOML file is the declarative descriptor that the aio-config generator uses to resolve and render the sibling fragment.Dockerfile. It classifies fd as a shell-category tool installed by mise and pins the build version to 10.5.0 via a [[versions]] entry. It is purely declarative configuration with no executable logic.
responsibilities: Identify the scenario to the aio-config fragment resolver
Pin the installable version(s) used to fill the fragment's version template
